note: Generic skill pack. Principal-specific rules, agent names and accounts live in the principal store under policies/ and agents/. Point skills.external_dirs at this folder.

skills.name: charts-in-posts
skills.description: Charts and visuals in GitHub posts: tables, Mermaid diagrams, hosted images, which to use and how to make each.
skills.generalized: Author line and script paths generalized.

skills.name: choreography
skills.description: Use when a multi-agent team needs its shared working contracts: the self-improving flywheel, anti-loop discipline, open-source contribution, and local preprocessing.
skills.generalized: New index SKILL.md over four kit contracts (flywheel, anti-loop, open-source contribution, local preprocessing). The tool-specific video route was left out.

skills.name: clean-writing
skills.description: Use when a human reads your writing. Cut filler.
skills.generalized: Public skill kept; added the mention rule and gate docs. check-prose.py moved into the skill as scripts/check-prose.py. Hard-coded internal names removed; extra banned phrases, internal names and limits load from <store>/policies/prose.json and policies/internal-names.txt.

skills.name: control-plane
skills.description: Use for any multi-agent dispatch, rotation, concurrency, GitHub workflow, or learning decision. Compact trigger index; load only the bundle the task names.
skills.generalized: Rewritten from the team's control plane. Seat names became roles (mission control, orchestrator, specialists) with {{orchestrator_seat}} and {{mission_control_seat}} placeholders. Absolute paths, ledger row ids, dated owner rulings and the owner-only list moved out: records default to <store>/records/ops/, rulings and the owner-only list live in the principal store policies/. Gate scripts other than check-prose are planned for exo.dispatch and exo.records.

skills.name: council
skills.description: Use when a structured team council is convened: bounded question, role seats, evidence-led deliberation, decision record with owner-held gates, and execution handoff with receipts.
skills.generalized: Seat names replaced by roles; pilot lane names and the state-CLI reference generalized (mission-control state is a signed ledger event in Exo). Templates kept.

skills.name: exo-bus
skills.description: Message other agent seats over the signed, hash-chained Exo Bus: post, inbox, threads, claims, verify.
skills.source: aska-digital/divan-bus SPEC.md and README (client usage); skill ~/.hermes/skills/divan-bus not copied
skills.generalized: Rewritten for exo.bus and the exo-bus plugin tools. Seat names, relay host and leader seat removed; config by EXO_BUS_* variables; registry and seats are principal data.

skills.name: git-authorship-identity-cleanup
skills.description: Use when internal names leak into public git commits.

skills.name: github-draft-review-html
skills.description: Use when a GitHub issue/PR draft must be shown for review. Render it as a self-contained GitHub-dark single-file HTML.
skills.generalized: Renamed to match its frontmatter name. Owner handle, personal drafts folder, vault delivery and internal agent chain moved to settings: EXO_DRAFTS_ROOT, EXO_INTERNAL_NAMES, EXO_DRAFT_OWNERS, EXO_DRAFT_STATE. Identifier gate no longer hard-codes names; prose gate points at clean-writing/scripts/check-prose.py.

skills.name: github-issue-to-pr
skills.description: Carry a GitHub issue to a verified PR with honest CI state.

skills.name: github-issues
skills.description: Create, triage, label, assign GitHub issues via gh or REST.

skills.name: github-pr-audit
skills.description: Use when auditing a GitHub PR or issue before merge.
skills.generalized: Seat names to roles, script paths to <skills-root>, internal provenance labels removed.

skills.name: github-pr-workflow
skills.description: GitHub PR lifecycle: branch, commit, open, CI, merge.
skills.generalized: Copied; no principal content found beyond generic examples.

skills.name: jevgrep
skills.description: Use for questions about how, why or where behavior works in a codebase when you do not yet know which files matter. Calls code_find, which returns relevant files and verbatim excerpts.
skills.generalized: Rewritten for the Exo code_find tool: no CLI setup or auth steps, backend line, paging and privacy notes added. Credit and link kept.

skills.name: operating-doctrine
skills.description: Use when running any project with the Protean pipeline. Default stages, delegation map, handoff protocol, and QA gates.
skills.generalized: Public doctrine kept nearly verbatim (already role-named). Added the six pre-merge gates, escape routing, adversarial QA and the two-team bounce from the team copy with agent names replaced by roles. Commit identity table with personal addresses removed. Principal note added.

skills.name: sym-protocol
skills.description: Use when validating or emitting SYM-2P/1.0 packets or blackboard objects. Stdlib validator with typed fail-closed diagnostics, brief/receipt packet templates, and a worked review-fix-verify-merge example.
skills.generalized: Validator, templates and fixtures kept. Party ids in examples and fixtures renamed to role ids (orchestrator, builder, reviewer, control). Provenance paths into a personal profile cache removed. Library form is exo.protocols.sym2p.
